Household members
Fact.Description: List of household members; each one is independently evaluated for Medicaid / CHP+ / WAWD / CWD coverage.

Fact.Name: Income list
Fact.Description: Itemized household income sources; each is annualized by its frequency and classified as earned or unearned for the MAGI calculation.

Fact.Name: Member
Fact.Description: The household member who receives this income.

Fact.Name: Income type
Fact.Description: The source/type of this income.

Fact.Name: Amount
Fact.Description: The income amount at its stated frequency.

Fact.Name: Income frequency
Fact.Description: How often this income is received, used to annualize the amount.

Fact.Name: Is earned income
Fact.Description: Whether this income type is treated as earned income for MAGI: wages and salaries, agricultural stabilization payments, VISTA wages, sick/vacation/bonus pay while employed, vocational rehabilitation training allowances, WIOA on-the-job training, Title I VISTA payments, self-employment, LLC/S-Corporation owner income, or boarder income (mirrors SNAP, 10 CCR 2506-1, 4.403).

Fact.Name: Annualized amount
Fact.Description: This income's amount converted to an annual figure based on its frequency.

Fact.Name: Earned Income
Fact.Description: Annual household earned income, summed from the itemized income list (wages, self-employment, and other earned sources), each annualized by its frequency.

Fact.Name: Unearned Income
Fact.Description: Annual household unearned income, summed from the itemized income list (Social Security, pensions, unemployment, child support, investments, and other non-earned sources), each annualized by its frequency.

Fact.Name: Age
Fact.Description: Age of this member in years. Determines eligibility category (Infant, Young Child, Older Child, Adult) and work-requirement applicability.

Fact.Name: Children Due
Fact.Description: Number of children expected from this member's current pregnancy (0 if not pregnant). Adds to household size for FPL.

Fact.Name: Disabled
Fact.Description: Whether this member has a qualifying disability.

Fact.Name: Veteran
Fact.Description: Whether this member is a military veteran.

Fact.Name: Has Disabled Child
Fact.Description: Whether this member has a child with a disability in the household.

Fact.Name: Is Full-Time Student
Fact.Description: Whether this member is enrolled as a full-time student.

Fact.Name: Monthly Hours Worked
Fact.Description: Hours per month this member works.

Fact.Name: Immigrant Status
Fact.Description: This member's immigration / citizenship status.

Fact.Name: Receives SSI
Fact.Description: Whether this member receives Supplemental Security Income.

Fact.Name: Days Since Pregnancy
Fact.Description: Days since this member's pregnancy ended (used for postpartum coverage).

Fact.Name: Is Member
Fact.Description: Per-member sentinel boolean (always true) used to derive household_size via Count.

Fact.Name: Household Size
Fact.Description: Number of members in the household.

Fact.Name: Household Children Due
Fact.Description: Total children due across all members. Adds to household size for the Medicaid FPL calculation.

Fact.Name: Total Income
Fact.Description: Total annual household income (earned + unearned).

Fact.Name: FPL
Fact.Description: Federal Poverty Level: baseline + additional × (household_size − 1).

Fact.Name: Medicaid FPL
Fact.Description: Federal Poverty Level for Medicaid: baseline + additional × (household_size − 1 + total children due).

Fact.Name: Medicaid FPL Percent
Fact.Description: Total household income as a percentage of the Medicaid FPL.

Fact.Name: Medicaid Infant Financial
Fact.Description: Passes if Medicaid % FPL ≤ infant max FPL %.

Fact.Name: Medicaid Young Child Financial
Fact.Description: Passes if Medicaid % FPL ≤ young-child max FPL %.

Fact.Name: Medicaid Older Child Financial
Fact.Description: Passes if Medicaid % FPL ≤ older-child max FPL %.

Fact.Name: Medicaid Adult Financial
Fact.Description: Passes if Medicaid % FPL ≤ adult max FPL %.

Fact.Name: Medicaid Pregnant Financial
Fact.Description: Passes if Medicaid % FPL ≤ pregnant max FPL %.

Fact.Name: CHP+ Plan Level
Fact.Description: Determines CHP+ plan level for the household based on Medicaid % FPL.

Fact.Name: WAWD Countable Income
Fact.Description: SSA-based countable income: (unearned − exclusion) + ((earned − earned exclusion − remaining unearned exclusion) × earnedIncomePercent).

Fact.Name: WAWD % FPL
Fact.Description: WAWD income as a percentage of FPL.

Fact.Name: WAWD Income Eligible
Fact.Description: Passes if WAWD % FPL ≤ wawdFplPercentMax.

Fact.Name: CWD Countable Income
Fact.Description: CWD countable income: (gross − earned disregard) × (1 − gross disregard %), floored at 0.

Fact.Name: CWD % FPL
Fact.Description: CWD income as a percentage of FPL.

Fact.Name: CWD Income Eligible
Fact.Description: Passes if CWD % FPL ≤ cwdFplPercentMax.

Fact.Name: Meets Work Requirements
Fact.Description: Passes if monthly hours worked ≥ minimum, OR if exempt due to: full-time student, pregnant, disabled, veteran, has-disabled-child, or age outside the work range.

Fact.Name: Medicaid Legal Status Eligible
Fact.Description: Passes if immigrant status is Citizen, Legal Permanent Resident, or Cuban/Haitian Entrant.

Fact.Name: Medicaid Infant Non-Financial
Fact.Description: Passes if age < infant max age.

Fact.Name: Medicaid Infant
Fact.Description: Eligible as Infant if both household financial and member non-financial pass.

Fact.Name: Medicaid Young Child Non-Financial
Fact.Description: Passes if age is between infant_max_age (inclusive) and young_child_max_age (exclusive).

Fact.Name: Medicaid Older Child Non-Financial
Fact.Description: Passes if age is between young_child_max_age (inclusive) and older_child_max_age (exclusive).

Fact.Name: Medicaid Adult Non-Financial
Fact.Description: Passes if age is between older_child_max_age (inclusive) and adult_max_age (exclusive).

Fact.Name: Medicaid Pregnant Non-Financial
Fact.Description: Passes if currently pregnant OR within the postpartum coverage window.

Fact.Name: Medicaid SSI
Fact.Description: SSI recipients automatically qualify for Medicaid.

Fact.Name: Medicaid Category
Fact.Description: This member's Medicaid eligibility category. Categories checked in order: Infant, Young Child, Older Child, Pregnant, SSI recipient, Adult.

Fact.Name: Medicaid Eligible
Fact.Description: This member is eligible for Medicaid if work requirements are met, legal status is eligible, and Medicaid Category is not 'Ineligible'.

Fact.Name: CHP+ Age or Pregnant
Fact.Description: Passes if age < CHP+ max age, OR currently pregnant.

Fact.Name: CHP+ Not Other Program Eligible
Fact.Description: Passes if NOT eligible for Medicaid OR WAWD.

Fact.Name: CHP+
Fact.Description: Eligible for CHP+ if not other-program eligible, age/pregnant requirements met, and household plan level is not 'Not Eligible'.

Fact.Name: WAWD Not Medicaid Eligible
Fact.Description: Passes if NOT eligible for regular Medicaid.

Fact.Name: WAWD Immigration Eligible
Fact.Description: Passes if immigrant status is a citizen or lawfully present non-citizen (LPR, Refugee, Asylee, Cuban/Haitian Entrant, Deportation Withheld, Paroled 1+ year, TPS, or Conditional Entrant).

Fact.Name: Working Adults with Disabilities Buy-In
Fact.Description: Eligible for WAWD if all are met: not Medicaid eligible, immigration eligible, disabled, age eligible, working, and household income eligible.

Fact.Name: CWD Not Other Program Eligible
Fact.Description: Passes if NOT eligible for Medicaid, CHP+, or WAWD.

Fact.Name: Children with Disabilities Buy-In
Fact.Description: Eligible for CWD if all are met: not other-program eligible, disabled, age eligible, and household income eligible.
